menu.subtitle: An alien egg was discovered during a military operation. Since you touched it, the creature reacts to your decisions. Professor Chen begins a short protocol before it chooses its form.

dialogue.clickHint: Read the next message to continue the protocol.
dialogue.choiceHint: Choose an answer to influence the result.

final.noMutationText: No new threshold. The current form stabilizes.

confirmQuit.title: Quit the protocol?
confirmQuit.text: Your current progress will be reset and you will return to the main menu.

confirmStop.title: Stop testing this creature?
confirmStop.text: This action will stop the current tests on the creature and return you to the main menu.

lore.title: Discovery of the Egg
lore.text: During a security operation in a restricted zone, your unit discovered an egg of unknown origin. Its surface looked mineral, but a slow pulse vibrated beneath the shell.

lore.title: Accidental Contact
lore.text: You were assigned to protect the perimeter. When the egg began to crack, you touched it by reflex. At that moment, your heartbeat and its internal energy synchronized.

lore.title: Emotional Reaction
lore.text: Since the contact, the egg reacts to your mood shifts. Anger, fear, curiosity, calm: each emotion changes its temperature, color, and biological rhythm.

lore.title: Chen Protocol
lore.text: Before the full hatching, Professor Chen wants to understand the bond between you and the creature. You will go through behavioral tests to measure this synchronization.
